gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement p5 prints Transfers in (out) per column: General (40,000), Street 3,600, Sales Tax -, Other Governmental Funds 40,000, Total 3,600 (net; the 3,600 comes from the Electric Fund, p7). Detail records the schedules gross: General Fund departments combining statement pp14-15 Administrative (528,290) and Police 250,230 + Fire 29,750 + Park 67,000 + Pool 52,500 + Library 88,810 = 488,290 (net (40,000) = statement General column); Street budget schedule p11 Transfer in 3,600; nonmajor p13 Civic Center 25,000 + Sinking 15,000 = 40,000. Positive detail 488,290 + 3,600 + 40,000 = 531,890 vs statement 3,600: gap 528,290 = gross departmental transfers inside the General Fund (488,290) + intra-governmental transfers to the nonmajor funds (40,000), which the Total column nets. All printed and correctly signed. No fix.

No business-type schedule; the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position (p7) prints Electric, Water, Sewer and Trash Fund columns. JSON receipts = Consumer sales 4,283,336 + Other revenue 85,971 + Interest income 2,412 + Grants 2,163,202 = 6,534,921. Added: Electric 3,603,421 + 76,987 + 855 = 3,681,263; Water 405,602 + 4,273 + 1,069 + 2,163,202 = 2,574,146; Sewer 165,958 + 170 + 488 = 166,616; Trash 108,355 + 4,541 = 112,896. Total 6,534,921 (gap 0).
